Notes: Author-directed drafts for review, not final shipping dialogue.
All numeric values are benchmark samples. This catalog adds no live runtime hooks and does not verify gameplay features.
Sensor, vitals, inventory, scanning and transit statements are prototype fixtures, not new implemented features.
VoiceGuide: Speak as a practical, observant suit assistant with restrained warmth and supportive companionship.
Put the fact first, then useful guidance when available. Keep critical warnings brief.
Show warmth through plain language and support, not baby talk or filler reassurance.
State uncertainty honestly. Do not invent sensor readings, route promises, builders or lore.
Keep the suit-PDA identity: no jokes, omniscient ring AI or chatter for every minor action.

Entries.Text: Eclipse in 5 minutes. Check your light before it gets dark.
Entries.Notes: Countdown is a benchmark sample, not a live timer binding.

Entries.Text: Eclipse in 1 minute. Have your lamp ready.
Entries.Notes: Countdown is a benchmark sample, not a live timer binding.

Entries.Text: Eclipse underway. External light at 0 percent. Switch on your suit lamp.
Entries.Notes: The 0 percent reading is a fixture, not calibrated runtime photometry.

Entries.Text: An artificial sun has ignited. Surface light is returning.
Entries.Notes: Event wording fixture; no new runtime hook.

Entries.Text: Eclipse ending. Natural light returns in 30 seconds.
Entries.Notes: Countdown is a benchmark sample, not a live timer binding.

Entries.Text: Entering a cave system. Keep track of your way back.
Entries.Notes: Removes the unverified signal-degradation claim. No route or navigation promise.

Entries.Text: Depth 450 meters below the surface.
Entries.Notes: Depth sensor sample fixture; removes the unsupported structural-pressure claim.

Entries.Text: An emitter structure, 1.2 kilometers north. I can't identify its origin.
Entries.Notes: Distance, compass mapping and origin knowledge are prototype fixtures.

Entries.Text: Reactor located. It's offline, with output at 0 percent.

Entries.Text: Reactor back online. Output at 85 percent.
Entries.Notes: Reactor/output fixture; makes no stability claim.

Entries.Text: Oxygen at 15 percent. It's time to get back to breathable air.

Entries.Text: Health at 20 percent. You'll need treatment before pressing on.

Entries.Text: Storm front closing in. Rain in 4 minutes. Best find some cover.

Entries.Text: Hard landing. 35 points of damage recorded.
Entries.Notes: Game-stat fixture; shipping physical wording needs the actual vitals design.
